## 2. Clustering

```{r}
library(clValid)
library(dendextend)

data <- t(assay(SE, "min_max")) %>% as.matrix()

set.seed(25)
testCL<- clValid(data,
                 nClust = 8:20,
                 #clMethods = c("kmeans"),
                 clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),
                 validation="internal", 
                 metric="euclidean", 
                 method = "ward", 
                 maxitems = 5000)
summary(testCL)
plot(testCL, legend = FALSE)

#agnes_split <- as.dendrogram(agnes(scale(data),metric = "euclidean",method = "ward"))
#agnes_split <- color_branches(agnes_split, k = 4)
#plot(agnes_split)
```


```{r}
set.seed(22)
h_com <- Heatmap(data, 
        col = viridis(100), 
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        row_km = 18, 
        row_km_repeats = 10000,
        #cluster_rows = agnes_split,
        #row_split = 4,
        name = "min_max",
        show_row_names=FALSE)+
  Heatmap(scale(data), name = "scaled",
          clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
          show_row_names = FALSE)

h_com <- draw(h_com)


## Selection 
row_order_h_ag <- row_order(h_com)
anno <- data %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("ID") %>% select(ID)
anno$cluster_mz <- NA

library(foreach)
foreach(i = seq_along(row_order_h_ag))%do%{
anno$cluster_mz <- as.factor((ifelse(rownames(anno) %in% row_order_h_ag[[i]], i, anno$cluster_mz)))
}
anno$cluster_mz <- unfactor(anno$cluster_mz)

## Add to SE
SE$cluster_mz <- anno$cluster_mz[match(SE$ID, anno$ID)]
```

```{r}
          conf.int = FALSE
)
```


### Prepare MetaboAnalyst

```{r}
library(EnhancedVolcano)

# FUNCTION 1: Perform logFC/p-value and t-score estimation
log_FC_analysis <- function(SE, x, group) {
  
  category_name <- paste0(x, "_other")
  
  # 1. Create the new category variable based on the input x
  SE[[category_name]] <- ifelse(SE[[group]] == x, x, "Other")
  
  # 2. Aggregate expression per category
  mean_SE <- aggregateAcrossCells(SE,
                                  ids = SE[[category_name]],
                                  statistics = "mean",
                                  use.assay.type = "min_max")
  
  # 3. Calculate log-fold change (logFC)
  logFC <- log2(assay(mean_SE, "min_max")[, mean_SE[[category_name]] == x] /
                assay(mean_SE, "min_max")[, mean_SE[[category_name]] == "Other"])
  
  # 4. Calculate p-value (based on t-test)
  min_max <- as.data.frame(t(assay(SE, "min_max")))
  min_max[[category_name]] <- SE[[category_name]]
  
  p_value <- c()
  t_score <- c()
  for (i in 1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)) {
    t <- t.test(min_max[min_max[[category_name]] == x, i], 
                min_max[min_max[[category_name]] == "Other", i])
    p_value[i] <- t$p.value
    t_score[i] <- t$statistic
  }
  
  names(t_score) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  names(p_value) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  
  # 5. Adjust p-values for multiple testing (Optional)
  #p_value_adj <- p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  #names(p_value_adj) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  
  # 6. Prepare data for the volcano plot
  data <- as.data.frame(cbind(logFC, p_value))
  data$t_score <- t_score[match(rownames(data), names(t_score))]
  
  ## Custom Color
  keyvals <- ifelse(
    data$logFC < -0.2, "#377EB8",
    ifelse(data$logFC > 0.2, "#E41A1C", 'black')
  )
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#E41A1C"] <- paste("High", x)
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- 'Not Sig'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#377EB8"] <- 'High Other'
  
  # 7. Plot VolcanoPlot
  p <- EnhancedVolcano(data,
                  lab = rownames(data),
                  x = 'logFC',
                  y = 'p_value',
                  title = '',
                  boxedLabels =FALSE,
                  pCutoff = 0.05,
                  FCcutoff = 0.2,
                  drawConnectors = FALSE,
                  pointSize = 8.0,
                  labSize = 6.0, 
                  colCustom = keyvals)
  
  return(list(plot = p, data = data))
}


# FUNCTION 2: Save csv file for each group
save_csv_for_GSEA <- function(SE, group, phenotype, output_path) {
  result <- log_FC_analysis(SE, group, phenotype)
  
  mz_ranked <- result$data %>% arrange(p_value) %>% dplyr::select(p_value, t_score)
  mz_ranked <- mz_ranked %>% rownames_to_column("m.z")
  colnames(mz_ranked) <- c("m.z", "p.value", "t.score")
  
  # Save
  write.csv(mz_ranked, output_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
}
```

## 3. Metaclustering

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)

# Base directory
base_dir <- "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/GSEA/cluster_k_17/output"

# Get all out_* folders
out_folders <- list.dirs(base_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read one out_* folder
read_out_folder <- function(folder) {
  # CSV file
  csv_file <- file.path(folder, "mummichog_pathway_enrichment_mummichog.csv")
  df <- read_csv(csv_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  colnames(df)[1] <- "pathway"
  
  # JSON file
  json_file <- file.path(folder, "scattermum.json")
  jdat <- fromJSON(json_file)
  jdf <- tibble(
    path = unlist(jdat$pathnames),
    #p_scatter = unlist(jdat$pval),
    enr  = unlist(jdat$enr)
  )
  
  # Join CSV and JSON
  df <- df %>%
    left_join(jdf, by = c("pathway" = "path")) %>%
    mutate(group = basename(folder))
  
  return(df)
}

# Apply across all out_* folders and combine
all_results <- map_dfr(out_folders, read_out_folder)
```

```{r}
all_results$NES <- scale(all_results$enr, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

all_results <- all_results %>% mutate(log_p = -log10(`P(Fisher)`), scaled_NES = NES*-log10(`P(Fisher)`), scaled_enr = enr*-log10(`P(Fisher)`))

# Based on p-value only
result_mat_p <- all_results %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, group, log_p) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = log_p, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% t() %>% as.matrix()
Heatmap(result_mat_p, col = viridis(100))

# Based on scales_NES
result_mat_nes <- all_results %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, group, scaled_enr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = scaled_enr, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% t() %>% as.matrix()
Heatmap(result_mat_nes, col = viridis(100))
```

```{r}
## Column Anno
# Match Pathway Annotation
pathway_anno <- peak_anno_updated %>% dplyr::select(hsa_name, hsa_class) %>% unique
(result_mat_p %>% colnames)[!(result_mat_p %>% colnames) %in% pathway_anno$hsa_name]

pathway_anno <- bind_rows(
  pathway_anno,
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Drug metabolism - other enzymes", hsa_class = "Xenobiotics biodegradation and metabolism"),
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Drug metabolism - cytochrome P450", hsa_class = "Xenobiotics biodegradation and metabolism"),
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Terpenoid backbone biosynthesis", hsa_class = "Metabolism of terpenoids and polyketides"),
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism", hsa_class = "Amino acid metabolism"),
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Glycolysis or Gluconeogenesis", hsa_class = "Carbohydrate metabolism")
)

col_anno <- data.frame(fine = colnames(result_mat_p))
col_anno$broad <- pathway_anno$hsa_class[match(col_anno$fine, pathway_anno$hsa_name)]
col_broad <- setNames(brewer.pal(10, "Paired"), unique(col_anno$broad))
col_anno_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(broad = anno_simple(col_anno$broad, col = col_broad),
                                 fine = anno_text(col_anno$fine))

## Print heatmap
set.seed(22)
h_meta <- 
  Heatmap(result_mat_p, 
          col = viridis(100),
          #row_split = 4,
          row_km = 6, 
          row_km_repeats = 1000,
          clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
          clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
          column_title = NULL,
          column_split = col_anno$broad)%v%
  col_anno_ha

lgd_1 <- Legend(title = "Broad pathway",
                at = names(col_broad),
                legend_gp = gpar(fill = col_broad))


h_meta <- draw(h_meta, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_1))
```

```{r}
## PCA of cluster space

pca_summary <- summary(pca_res)
var_exp <- 100 * pca_summary$importance[2, 1:2]  # Proportion of variance for PC1 and PC2

df_pca <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2])
df_pca$label <- rownames(result_mat_nes)
df_pca$metacluster <- anno$metacluster[match(df_pca$label, anno$cluster)]

# Plot with variance explained in axis labels
ggplot(df_pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = metacluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_classic()

## PCA of metacluster space
pca_res <- prcomp(result_by_metacluster, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca_summary <- summary(pca_res)
var_exp <- 100 * pca_summary$importance[2, 1:2]  # Proportion of variance for PC1 and PC2

df_pca <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2])
df_pca$label <- rownames(result_by_metacluster)

# Plot with variance explained in axis labels
ggplot(df_pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = label)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
log_FC_analysis <- function(SE, x, group) {
  
  category_name <- paste0(x, "_other")
  
  # 1. Create the new category variable based on the input x
  SE[[category_name]] <- ifelse(SE[[group]] == x, x, "Other")
  
  # 2. Aggregate expression per category
  mean_SE <- aggregateAcrossCells(SE,
                                  ids = SE[[category_name]],
                                  statistics = "mean",
                                  use.assay.type = "min_max")
  
  # 3. Calculate log-fold change (logFC)
  logFC <- log2(assay(mean_SE, "min_max")[, mean_SE[[category_name]] == x] /
                assay(mean_SE, "min_max")[, mean_SE[[category_name]] == "Other"])
  
  # 4. Calculate p-value (based on t-test)
  min_max <- as.data.frame(t(assay(SE, "min_max")))
  min_max[[category_name]] <- SE[[category_name]]
  
  p_value <- c()
  t_score <- c()
  for (i in 1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)) {
    t <- t.test(min_max[min_max[[category_name]] == x, i], 
                min_max[min_max[[category_name]] == "Other", i])
    p_value[i] <- t$p.value
    t_score[i] <- t$statistic
  }
  
  names(t_score) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  names(p_value) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  
  # 5. Adjust p-values for multiple testing (Optional)
  #p_value_adj <- p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  #names(p_value_adj) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  
  # 6. Prepare data for the volcano plot
  data <- as.data.frame(cbind(logFC, p_value))
  data$t_score <- t_score[match(rownames(data), names(t_score))]
  
  ## Custom Color
  keyvals <- ifelse(
    data$logFC < -0.2, "#377EB8",
    ifelse(data$logFC > 0.2, "#E41A1C", 'black')
  )
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#E41A1C"] <- paste("High", x)
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- 'Not Sig'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#377EB8"] <- 'High Other'
  
  # 7. Plot VolcanoPlot
  p <- EnhancedVolcano(data,
                  lab = rownames(data),
                  x = 'logFC',
                  y = 'p_value',
                  title = '',
                  boxedLabels =FALSE,
                  pCutoff = 0.05,
                  FCcutoff = 0.2,
                  drawConnectors = FALSE,
                  pointSize = 8.0,
                  labSize = 6.0, 
                  colCustom = keyvals)
  
  return(list(plot = p, data = data))
}

save_csv_for_GSEA <- function(SE, group, phenotype, output_path) {
  result <- log_FC_analysis(SE, group, phenotype)
  
  mz_ranked <- result$data %>% arrange(p_value) %>% dplyr::select(p_value, t_score)
  mz_ranked <- mz_ranked %>% rownames_to_column("m.z")
  colnames(mz_ranked) <- c("m.z", "p.value", "t.score")
  
  # Save
  write.csv(mz_ranked, output_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
}
```

### Survival associated metabolites 

```{r}
metabo_df <- t(assay(SE, "min_max")) %>% as.data.frame 

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
metabo_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(metabo_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
metabo_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(metabo_df[,i] > median(metabo_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

#colnames(metabo_df_mean) <- colnames(metabo_df)
rownames(metabo_df_mean) <- rownames(metabo_df)
metabo_df_mean <- as.data.frame(metabo_df_mean)

#colnames(metabo_df_mean) <- str_replace(colnames(metabo_df), "\\.", "_")

metabo_df_mean$status_OS <- SE$status_OS[match(rownames(metabo_df), SE$ID)]
metabo_df_mean$OS_months <- SE$OS_months[match(rownames(metabo_df), SE$ID)]

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(metabo_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  metabo_df_mean[[x]] <- factor(metabo_df_mean[[x]], levels = c("A", "B"))
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = metabo_df_mean)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Match m/z names back 
match <- data.frame(mz = colnames(metabo_df), result = colnames(metabo_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS, -OS_months)))
cur_surv_out$group <- match$mz[match(cur_surv_out$group, match$result)]


# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)
cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))


cur_surv_plot$type <- "metabolites"

ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=reorder(group,ratio), y = type, col = ratio, size= -log10(p)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = cur_surv_plot, shape = 1, aes(size = -log10(p), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()

```
